title: Total Fu for the Hand
description: Add up the fu of a whole riichi mahjong hand and answer the total after rounding up, in one go
prompt: Answer the total fu for this hand

howToPlay.title: Question format
howToPlay.lead: You will get questions like this.

up_to_40.label: Up to 40 fu
up_to_40.hint: Pinfu tsumo, chiitoitsu, 30 fu and 40 fu: the range that comes up most in real games

up_to_60.label: Up to 60 fu
up_to_60.hint: Everything up to 40 fu, plus 50 fu and 60 fu hands where closed triplets and quads pile up

all.label: All
all.hint: Every hand, including the rare ones of 70 fu or more
